text:
Dear Mr. Pereira,

Thank you for submitting a tender for the refurbishment of the municipal swimming pool. The evaluation panel received eleven bids, and comparing them was a difficult task. [1] I regret to inform you that, on this occasion, your bid has not been successful.

The panel scored every tender against the published criteria, giving the greatest weight to [2] experience of comparable projects. Your bid was competitive on price; [3], it scored lower on the programme of works, which the panel considered optimistic. You are entitled to request a debrief, [4] must be made in writing within ten days of this letter.

Yours sincerely,
Marianne Voss
Procurement Officer

choices: The standard of submissions was high, which made the final ranking a matter of fine margins.
The standard of submissions was uneven, which made the final ranking a simple matter of elimination.
The contract was awarded to the lowest bidder, which made the final ranking a matter of price alone.
The standard of submissions was high, which is why the panel has decided to invite further bids.
questions.explanation: The previous sentence says comparing the bids was difficult, so the next must explain why; only the first does. The others contradict the difficulty (simple elimination, price alone) or the rejection that follows (further bids).
'Demonstrable experience' is the fixed collocation meaning experience that can be shown; 'demonstrative' means openly expressive, and the others are not adjectives that fit.
The sentence contrasts good price performance with a lower score on the programme; 'however' marks that contrast.
'Which' refers to the whole request for a debrief and is the subject of 'must be made'.

text:
Offshore Wind Auction Draws Record Bids

The government's latest auction for offshore wind capacity has attracted bids totaling nearly eleven gigawatts, which is [1] double the amount on offer. [2] The enthusiasm of developers reflects falling turbine costs and a guaranteed price for the electricity generated over fifteen years.

Critics warn that the system exposes consumers to risk if wholesale prices fall, because the difference must be [3] by consumers through their bills. Ministers [4] that the guarantee is necessary to attract investment in an industry where upfront costs are high.

questions.explanation: Nearly eleven gigawatts against the amount on offer means 'more than double'; the other comparatives change the meaning.

choices: Officials described the response as far weaker than anyone in the industry had feared.
Officials described the response as far stronger than anyone in the industry had predicted.
Officials described the auction as far costlier than anyone in the industry had predicted.
Developers described the response of officials as far stronger than anyone in the industry had predicted.
questions.explanation: The next sentence refers to 'the enthusiasm of developers', so the previous one must report a strong response; the others report a weak one, a cost, or shift the subject.
A difference in price 'must be met' by someone, meaning paid; the other verbs do not fit.
Ministers 'contend that' the guarantee is necessary, meaning argue; 'contest' means dispute the claim, which would reverse the meaning.

text:
CHANGES TO REFUSE COLLECTION – MILLBROOK DISTRICT

From Monday 6 October, household waste in the Millbrook district will be collected fortnightly rather than weekly. [1] Food waste and recycling will continue to be collected every week, and residents will be given a larger bin for the purpose.

The council anticipates that the change will [2] around £400,000 a year and will encourage households to recycle more. [3] the proposal was subject to public consultation, a majority of respondents opposed it. Residents who produce unusually large quantities of waste, [4] families with infants, may apply for an additional bin.

choices: The change applies to general household waste only and does not affect any other collection service.
The change applies to commercial waste only and does not affect any household collection service.
The change applies to general household waste only and will also affect food waste and recycling.
The change was proposed after a review of the general waste service and will take effect next autumn.
questions.explanation: The next sentence says food waste and recycling continue weekly, so the previous one must limit the change to general waste; the others contradict the first sentence or the date.
A change that cuts costs will 'save' £400,000; the other verbs do not take a sum as object in that sense.
'Even though the proposal was subject to public consultation' states a fact and contrasts it with the opposition; 'even if' would make it hypothetical.
'Such as families with infants' introduces an example of residents with large amounts of waste.
